messages:
Priya: Hey team — customer (FinServ X) wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Key asks: signed offline bundle, SBOM, delta updates, install window, KMS/HSM integration, upgrade cadence, license activation offline. What's feasible?

Leo: We can do signed bundles + SBOM. Need packaging constraints: how big (model weights) and how many bundles. Will need to know allowed update cadence.

Maya: Also need to confirm they can host a "jumpbox" for initial bootstrap or we provide a USB-sideload workflow. For largest models >20GB we recommend chunked bundles.

Jordan: Technical: our offline installer supports chunked tarballs, sha256 checksums, and signed manifests. Example:

```
sha256sum redwood-bundle-v1.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify public.pem -signature bundle.sig redwood-bundle-v1.tar.gz
```

Leo: For tooling, we provide a "shipyard" sideload workflow with delta patches. Deltas currently limited to same-major version; patch cadence we recommend monthly security patches, feature rollouts quarterly. Canary in air-gap is manual.

Priya: Licensing question — can we do time-limited offline activation with license key? They asked about floating license across air-gapped nodes.

Sam: Legal: floating license ok, but need offline attestation token. We'll need to confirm export control for model binaries.

Maya: Security questionnaire Q: Do we allow HSM? Yes, we support external KMS via KMIP and HSM via PKCS#11. But for air-gapped, customer must provide HSM appliance with local certs.

Jordan: Also note: automatic telemetry is disabled in air-gap by default. Support must be via uploaded debug bundle. We need a secure channel for logs; pre-signed upload or SFTP.

Priya: Ops ask: SLA? For Dedicated/on-prem combos we offer 99.5 with paid support. For POC it's best-effort with 24h response M-F.

Leo: Also packaging size: can we compress quantized weights to reduce bundle size? Yes, we can provide int8 quantized model binaries; need to confirm model acceptance policy.

Priya: Can we include pricing guidance? Customer asked for delta between hosted and on-prem. Quick note: offline POC one-time packaging fee + per-node license. I'll draft numbers and sync.

Maya: Action items: Leo - produce sample signed bundle + manifest. Jordan - write install step-by-step and bootstrap options. Sam - check export/control flags and license template. Priya - schedule customer call Wednesday 10am PT. @Leo @Jordan @Sam

Leo: Working on bundle, ETA EOD Tue. will include checksums and SBOM.

Jordan: I'll drop an install snippet and jumpbox steps by tomorrow.

Sam: On export controls — flagging that certain models may need review; I'll follow up with legal team.

shipyard-bot: New artifact uploaded: redwood-bundle-v1.0.sig (checksum pass) — internal note

Priya: Thanks all. I'll prep the SOW draft and include the package fee — looping in finance after call. :thumbsup:
